description: This file contains the implementation of the Twig class within the Opencart System Library Template namespace. It provides functionality to load, manage, and render Twig templates, including adding custom paths, handling template code, and configuring the Twig environment.

classes.name: Twig
classes.description: A class providing methods to load, manage, and render Twig templates within the OpenCart system. It includes methods for adding paths, rendering templates with data, and configuring the Twig environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig class, setting up the root directory and the Twig loader.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new template path associated with a namespace or sets the default directory if only one argument is provided.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a Twig template file with the provided data and optional code override, returning the resulting string.
